question: Which Indian journalist was awarded the Windham-Campbell Prize 2019 for the book 'Farthest Field: An Indian Story of the Second World War'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Raghu Karnad.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Journalist and writer Raghu Karnad won the $165,000 Windham-Campbell Prize in the non-fiction category for his debut book,** The Farthest Field: An Indian Story Of The Second World War.**
 
• Karnad is the **second Indian to receive the prestigious prize, since Jerry Pinto won it for his novel, Em And The Big Hoom, in 2016.**
 
• The Windham-Campbell Prize was** established in 2013**.
 
• Windham-Campbell Prize is an American Literary Prize.
 
• It is awarded in 4 categories -
 
 
• Fiction, non-fiction, poetry and drama with two winners in each category.
 
 
 
• **Raghu Karnad (India) and Rebecca Solnit (United States) won the prize in Non- fiction category.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mrinal Pande:**

• She was appointed chairperson of** Prasar Bharati, the official apex body of Indian broadcast media.**
